description: List folders in a BrowserStack Test Management project, returning each folder's id and name (plus case counts and sub-folder counts). Pass parent_id to list sub-folders under a specific folder instead of top-level folders. Requires a project identifier (PR-*). No tool here lists projects, so if you do not have one, call askBrowserStackAI with product "tm" and ask which projects exist, then retry this tool with the identifier it returns.

parent_id.description: If provided, list sub-folders under this parent folder id. If omitted, lists top-level folders.

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch folders from (starts with PR- followed by a number).

name: listFolders
